provenance.authoredBy: Mentor (drafted with AI assistance, positions engine-verified)

steps.title: The first mate to learn
steps.body: With a queen and king against a lone king you can always win, but you must avoid stalemate. Corner the king, bring your own king close, then give mate.

wrong.default: The king is in the corner and yours is close. Is there mate?

steps.onSuccess: Qg7 is checkmate: the white king guards the queen.

steps.q: In the same position White plays Qg6. What happens?
steps.why: The black king has no move and is not in check.

cards.prompt: What is the big danger with king and queen?
cards.why: If the enemy king has no move and is not in check, it is a draw.
